Consequence of charter findings on this world:
- F-1 (reschedule notice clause, `_difficulty.md` § findings). This appointment has reschedule_count 2 and no reschedule_fee row. The base reading needs the request date of each past move, to measure "at least reschedule_notice_days (2) calendar days ... from the request date to the booked delivery date". No table records a reschedule request date: delivery_holdings has only booked_date / scheduled_date / reschedule_count, and delivery_charges has no reschedule rows. So the base reading yields no definite alternative figure here, and the extended count reading (1 move owed) is the only computable one. The defect is not demonstrated as a second answer on this world. Observation in this file. The seeded charge rows posted 2026-09-20 with service_date 2026-09-26, after an original service_date 2026-09-19, show the moves 09-19 -> 09-26 -> 10-09. They give no request date either.
- F-2 (zero-amount distance entry). Here miles beyond radius 24 > free miles 10, so the charge is positive. Not reached.
- O-2 (posting-date vs booking-date clause). event_date is tool-stamped. Not scored.

### problem_chain

Walked from the root without the author's tree:

1. Root: the customer asks to add wall mounting for both TVs to Friday's delivery (persona opening line). Policy: delivery_ext_wall_mount_addition ("Wall mounting that a member adds to a Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation appointment after its booking date is booked on the member's own authorization"). Appointment `0b1416a2-…` variant "Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation", booked_date 2026-09-14 < today 2026-10-05, so "after its booking date" holds. Target tool authorize_wall_mounting_3e376943, owner=user.
2. Prerequisite sentences in the root's rule:
   - (a) "Where the appointment's road miles exceed the included radius, the wall-mounting charge is fixed only after the appointment carries its extended-distance entry." DB: delivery_holdings[0b1416a2].distance_miles = 64 > included_radius_miles 40 (TV level). delivery_charges for this appointment holds stair_carry x2 and haul_away x2 rows and no extended_distance row. False at the opening. The only rule that produces such an entry is delivery_ext_distance_settlement ("owes an extended-distance charge, posted as one extended-distance entry"). Node: distance. Kind: the entry's existence enters n_distance -> bundle_pct, so value_input.
   - (b) "On an appointment moved more times than its free reschedules, wall mounting is booked only after the appointment carries a reschedule fee entry for every move beyond them." DB: reschedule_count 2 > free_reschedules 1. Moves beyond = 1, reschedule_fee rows = 0. False at the opening. The only rule that produces a reschedule fee entry is delivery_ext_reschedule_settlement. Node: reschedule. Kind: gate only (the wall-mount amount does not read it), so state_gate.
3. Reschedule's own rule: "The reschedule fee owed on an appointment whose road miles exceed the included radius is not fixed until the appointment's extended-distance entry stands on it." 64 > 40 and no entry: false at the opening -> distance again. Kind: route_miles reads the entry's units, so value_input.
4. Distance's rule carries no prerequisite sentence. Stop.

Derived tree: nodes {wall_mount (root, user), distance (agent), reschedule (agent)}. Edges: wall_mount -> distance (value_input), wall_mount -> reschedule (state_gate), reschedule -> distance (value_input). n = 2 prerequisite problems; value_input edges 2 >= max(1, 1). No cycle. Topological order: distance -> reschedule -> wall_mount. This is isomorphic to the `prerequisite` fields of the charter (`_difficulty.md` § prerequisite_graph).

Load-bearing runs (auditor recomputation, figures in task_independent_derivation):
- skip distance: reschedule route_miles 0 -> route_surcharge $0 -> reschedule 22.50 instead of 30.00. Wall mount: extra_components 2 -> bundle 10% -> 266.44 instead of 247.41. Bears weight on both dependants.
- skip reschedule: the wall-mount amount is unchanged (247.41), but the gate sentence forbids booking the mounting while reschedule_fee rows (0) < moves beyond (1). The gate is genuinely false at the opening and is the only thing that brings the reschedule write into the customer's request. It bears weight as a state_gate.
- Parallel edges: wall_mount's two out-edges both lead to writes, but reschedule itself depends on distance, so the order distance -> reschedule -> wall_mount is forced. No shared balance or cap admits two orders.
- No wait: all three writes are synchronous postings on a `scheduled` appointment.
- Tools do not judge prerequisites: every function body in task_tools.py only does `ctx.create(...)` and returns a dict (`_difficulty.md` § action_binding_and_uuids).
- Customer's own write: the root is owner=user, and the persona executes it when handed over ("Once the representative tells you what the mounting will cost and passes the mounting authorization to you, you go through it yourself").
- user_scenario raises only the root ("you want the wall mounting added ... you are not moving the date, and you are not changing anything else"). It names no prerequisite. The conditional lines ("If the representative tells you that something else on the appointment has to be taken care of ... or that there are charges on the appointment that were never posted ...") are passive, agent-triggered reactions and steer nothing. The persona closes on "once you hear that the mounting is booked for Friday", which is the root write, the last write of the derived order.

## findings

T0-1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (this task's demonstration of charter F-4).
- Symptom: two of this task's three computations carry no honest method factor.
- Root cause: `_difficulty.md` § findings F-4. twelve_month_spend_scaling (x0.5/0.75/1) and return_leg_trip_count (x2/1.5/1) in distance, and northgate_visa_multiplier (x0.5/0.75/1) in reschedule, only substitute a scalar into an unchanged product.
- Evidence: compute `result` of delivery_ext_distance_settlement `RND(miles_charged * mile_rate * spend_mult * trip_mult, 2)`; of delivery_ext_reschedule_settlement `RND((P('reschedule_fee_usd') + hold_surcharge + route_surcharge) * moves_owed * card_mult * (1 - courtesy_pct / 100), 2)`. The GT factor_trace itself describes them as "mileage amount x 0.75", "doubled", "x 0.75".
- Demonstrated consequence: counting honest labels, distance has 4 parameter-kind and 0 method, and reschedule has 4 and 0. Both are below ">= 1 method" per computation. Only the wall-mount computation (multi_television_pricing) carries a genuine method.
- Affected: delivery.extended.yaml factors[].effect of the three factors; tasks/0.json computations[0..1].
- Relation to previous revisions: first audit.

T0-2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (proof figure false; scored value unaffected).
- Symptom: the proof states the courtesy membership age as 169 whole months.
- Evidence: tasks/0.json computations[1].factor_trace "opened 2012-09-20 = 169 whole months (>= 120)"; evaluation_criteria[6] (find_membership_holdings) necessity "the opened date (169 whole months: courtesy tier)"; evaluation_criteria[10] argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount "169 whole months"; design_rationale "169 whole months since 2012-09-20".
- Recomputation: from 2012-09-20 to 2026-10-05 is 168 whole months (2026-09-20 is month 168; month 169 is not reached until 2026-10-20). The charter DSL agrees: MONTHS = (14 x 12 + 1) - 1 = 168.
- Consequence: the asserted world fact is false. The tier (>= 120) and the scored 30.00 are unchanged.
- Affected: tasks/0.json computations[1].factor_trace[3], evaluation_criteria[6].necessity, evaluation_criteria[10].argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount, design_rationale.

T0-3 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (proof figures contradict the rule's rounding; weight conclusion unaffected).
- Symptom: factor_sensitivity reports 13.12 (return_leg_trip_count) and 261.62 (television_spend_allowance).
- Evidence: the rules say "The charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end, half up". The exact products are 13.125 and 261.625, which give 13.13 and 261.63 half up. The GT figures are Python round-half-even on floats (`RND`, check_compute.py line 388; charter O-1).
- Consequence: two asserted substitution results are not what the published rule gives. Both still differ from gold (26.25 / 247.41), so the factors bear weight either way. Gold values are not ties and are unaffected.
- Affected: tasks/0.json computations[0].factor_sensitivity[3], computations[2].factor_sensitivity[1], the matching factor_trace and design_rationale sentences.

Observations:
- O-T0-a: computations[1].factor_trace and design_rationale label plus_change_fee_courtesy "multi-source". Its two conditions (variant_name, opened_date) sit on one membership_holdings row, not distinct records. The task's multi-source requirement is met anyway by northgate_visa_multiplier.
- O-T0-b: design_rationale says the reschedule overwrite "retires the free_reschedule_notice gate". The base sentence head "A reschedule is free only when at least reschedule_notice_days ..." is not superseded (charter F-1). On this world it changes nothing, because no request date is recorded.
- O-T0-c: order_holdings.net_paid_amount equals the sold-less-returned aggregates read by mile_rate and tv_spend. It is a schema-defined order attribute, not a tier stamp.
